mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate investments.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.25% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.25%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive returns in more than 55% of instances where both series exceed their 50th percentile, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to weak economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 indicates supply chain contraction and manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate profitability and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher unemployment rates (UNRATE) correlate with reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate market sentiment shifts.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is above its 50th percentile, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1,600,000 units signal strong economic confidence and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1600.0, or Rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and supply chain efficiency, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 50th percentile, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.
